## Problem and change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Explain any checks you could not run.
For documentation changes, check links, commands and rendering. For UI changes, include screenshots and
identify the themes and languages checked.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes relevant documentation or examples.
- [ ] Meaningful behavior changes have appropriate tests, or this is a documentation-only change.
- [ ] UI text changes update both English and Spanish bundles, or no UI text changed.
- [ ] No proprietary binaries, generated build output or private machine configuration are included.
